description: Get the one link a business owner opens to put WhatsApp on their KaiCalls number. They sign in to Facebook as an admin of the business's Meta Business account and verify the number; the business owns its WhatsApp account. Uses the business's oldest KaiCalls line unless phone_number names another of its lines. Returns the same link while it is still valid (up to 3 days). Owner or admin only. Creates nothing billable and connects nothing by itself: get_whatsapp_status reports the connection after the owner finishes, and WhatsApp is not connected until it says so.

phone_number.description: E.164, one of the business lines.

name: connect_whatsapp
title: Connect WhatsApp
